summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and API upgrades. Additionally, there are ongoing proposals to enhance the REST catalog with new features like the X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header and a first-class Tag concept.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes cover variant support and DSv2 API upgrades
Proposal for OpenTelemetry MetricsReporter to improve observability
Discussion on ambiguity in Avro schema for day partition transform
Kafka connector version 1.11.0 accepted on Confluent Hub
